description:
This is a special bike. Limited to a production of 4 frames. This step thru El Continente is a small/medium but we did 2 of them in m/l too.

Paul everything. Klampers, hubs, post, stem. It's almost everything they make. Broke up the purple a little bit…but not too much.

Hand built stans hoops laced with our raw brass nips and double butted sapim spokes.

To get some gear range with are using a really spinny gear with a Schlumpf overdrive bottom bracket that shifts with a click of the heal. I love these drivetrains.. so clean and little to no adjustment… fun fact, I rode the tour divide on a Schlumpf.

White industries headset and super cool odd-one chainring from Endless

This is a special bike with an all out build.. if you like good clean fun and also may have errands to run… this could be for you

this ones sold but i have 1 more s/m frame availabale to build how you want.
